page.layout: One column of running text, with three marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top of the text block. Page number at top left. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: Semina purgatia.Hactenus semina alterantia: Sequu-tur purgantia.
Bilem: ut Psillii, Thymelaeae seu coc-cognidii, Thlaspi, &c.
Pituitam, Carthami seu Cnici, Geni-stae, Latyris seu cataputicae[?], Ricini, &c.
De lignis.Adhuc de feminibus: Sequuntur li-gna, &c.
Lignorum qualita-tes prima.Ligna sunt partes plantarum tanquam ossa in animalibus durissimae ac firmissimae.
Horum quaedam alterant manifesta, quaedam occulta qualitate.
Manifesta alterantia, Calida sunt vel Frigida.
Calida: Lignum aloes, Aspalatus[?], Buxus, Guaiacum, Indicum, Ebenum, Juniperinum, Narcaphthum, Viscum quercinum, Xylo casia sassafras, Lignum aromaticum, Lignum ad renū affectiones, &c.
Frigida: Cypressi, Loti arboris, Santalum album, rubrum & citrinum, Tamaricis, &c.

page.notes: The left-margin notes are set beside the paragraphs they stand against. The faint mark at the foot near the centre (possibly a gathering signature) is not clearly legible and is left out. Doubtful readings: "cataputicae" (the printed form is hard to read), "Aspalatus" (the initial is unclear), "renū" (macron uncertain). The running head "SECVNDI" is given as "SECUNDI" under the u/v rule. The final line may continue onto the foot of the page, where "lari-" is printed as the catchword.
